import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

class Center(string chart, local dataset.Lot[] lots)
    local defectives := 0
    local defects := 0
    local inspected := 0
    for lot := lots[]
        defectives += lot.defectives
        defects += lot.defects
        inspected += lot.inspected
    fraction := real64(defectives) / real64(inspected)
    value := fraction
    if chart == "np"
        value = real64(defectives) / real64(#lots)
    elif chart == "c"
        value = real64(defects) / real64(#lots)
    elif chart == "u"
        value = real64(defects) / real64(inspected)

class Point(local dataset.Lot lot, local Center center)
    real64 value := 0.0
    local real64 sigma := 0.0
    if center.chart == "p"
        value = real64(lot.defectives) / real64(lot.inspected)
        sigma = math.sqrt(center.value * (1.0 - center.value) / real64(lot.inspected))
    elif center.chart == "np"
        value = real64(lot.defectives)
        sigma = math.sqrt(center.value * (1.0 - center.fraction))
    elif center.chart == "c"
        value = real64(lot.defects)
        sigma = math.sqrt(center.value)
    else
        value = real64(lot.defects) / real64(lot.inspected)
        sigma = math.sqrt(center.value / real64(lot.inspected))
    real64 lcl := math.max(0.0, center.value - 3.0 * sigma)
    real64 ucl := center.value + 3.0 * sigma
    real64 z := (value - center.value) / sigma
    status := "ok"
    if value > ucl
        status = "high"
    elif value < lcl
        status = "low"

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import variable = "./variable_charts.qui"

class Indices(local real64 mean, local real64 sigma, local dataset.Settings settings)
    real64 potential := real64(settings.usl - settings.lsl) / (6.0 * sigma)
    real64 upper := (real64(settings.usl) - mean) / (3.0 * sigma)
    real64 lower := (mean - real64(settings.lsl)) / (3.0 * sigma)
    real64 minimum := math.min(upper, lower)

class Interval(local real64 index, local int count, local real64 z)
    local real64 delta := z * math.sqrt(1.0 / real64(9 * count) + index * index / real64(2 * (count - 1)))
    real64 lower := index - delta
    real64 upper := index + delta

string classify(real64 cpk)
    if cpk >= 1.33
        return "capable"
    if cpk >= 1.0
        return "marginal"
    return "incapable"

class HistogramBin(int lower, int upper, int frequency, int length, string[] marks)

HistogramBin[] histogram(int[] values, dataset.Settings settings)
    width := settings.histogram_bin
    low := settings.lsl
    high := settings.usl
    for value := values[]
        low = math.min(low, value)
        high = math.max(high, value)
    low = width * (low / width)
    high = width * (high / width) + width
    frequencies := array(nat((high - low) / width), fill = 0)
    for value := values[]
        frequencies[(value - low) / width] += 1
    top := 0
    for frequency := frequencies[]
        top = math.max(top, frequency)
    HistogramBin[] result := []
    for: index < #frequencies
        lower := low + int(index) * width
        upper := lower + width - 1
        frequency := frequencies[index]
        string[] marks := []
        if lower <= settings.lsl <= upper
            marks = marks.append("lsl")
        if lower <= settings.target <= upper
            marks = marks.append("target")
        if lower <= settings.usl <= upper
            marks = marks.append("usl")
        result = result.append(HistogramBin(lower, upper, frequency, (50 * frequency + top - 1) / top, marks))
    return result

class Result(local variable.Subgroup[] groups, local dataset.Settings settings, local dataset.Constants constants)
    local int[] values := []
    local range_sum := 0
    local real64 sd_sum := 0.0
    for group := groups[]
        values = values.concat(group.values)
        range_sum += group.spread
        sd_sum += group.sd
    count := int(#values)
    real64 mean := real64(variable.total_values(values)) / real64(count)
    real64 sigma_within := (real64(range_sum) / real64(#groups)) / constants.d2
    real64 sigma_sbar := (sd_sum / real64(#groups)) / constants.c4
    local real64 squares := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        offset := real64(value) - mean
        squares += offset * offset
    real64 sigma_overall := math.sqrt(squares / real64(count - 1))
    within := Indices(mean, sigma_within, settings)
    overall := Indices(mean, sigma_overall, settings)
    local offset := mean - real64(settings.target)
    real64 cpm := real64(settings.usl - settings.lsl) / (6.0 * math.sqrt(sigma_overall * sigma_overall + offset * offset))
    cpk_interval := Interval(within.minimum, count, settings.ci_z)
    ppk_interval := Interval(overall.minimum, count, settings.ci_z)
    below := 0
    above := 0
    for value := values[]
        if value < settings.lsl
            below += 1
        if value > settings.usl
            above += 1
    ppm := real64(1000000 * (below + above)) / real64(count)
    string verdict := classify(within.minimum)
    bins := histogram(values, settings)

class Constants(real64 a2, real64 a3, real64 b3, real64 b4, real64 d3, real64 d4, real64 d2, real64 c4)

        [0.419, 1.182, 0.118, 1.882, 0.076, 1.924, 2.704, 0.9594],

class Settings(string characteristic, int lsl, int usl, int target, int size, int phase1, int max_passes, int[][] rules, real64 cusum_k, real64 cusum_h, real64 ewma_lambda, real64 ewma_l, int ma_span, int event_gap, real64 ci_z, int histogram_bin, int rolling_window, int rolling_step)

Settings read_settings()
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/spec.txt"))
    string[][] fields := []
    for line := text.split(NL)[]
        if line != ""
            fields = fields.append(line.split(" "))
    int[][] rules := []
    for: 7 <= row < 14
        int[] selected := []
        for: 2 <= column < int(#fields[row])
            selected = selected.append(int(fields[row][column]))
        rules = rules.append(selected)
    return Settings(
        fields[0][1], int(fields[1][1]), int(fields[2][1]),
        int(fields[3][1]), int(fields[4][1]), int(fields[5][1]),
        int(fields[6][1]), rules, real64(fields[14][1]),
        real64(fields[15][1]), real64(fields[16][1]),
        real64(fields[17][1]), int(fields[18][1]),
        int(fields[19][1]), real64(fields[20][1]),
        int(fields[21][1]), int(fields[22][1]), int(fields[23][1])
    )

class Lot(int number, int inspected, int defectives, int defects)

int[] read_measurements()
    int[] result := []
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/measurements.csv"))

Lot[] read_attributes()
    Lot[] result := []

    lines := text.split(NL)

        if lines[index] != ""
            fields := lines[index].split(",")
            result = result.append(Lot(int(fields[0]), int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
    return result

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"
import variable = "./variable_charts.qui"
import attribute = "./attribute_charts.qui"
import rules = "./run_rules.qui"
import capability = "./capability.qui"
import plot = "./plot.qui"

string[] chart_names()
    return ["XBAR_R", "R", "XBAR_S", "S", "I", "MR", "CUSUM", "EWMA", "MA"]

string[] family_names()
    return ["XBAR_R", "XBAR_S", "I_MR"]

int[] consecutive(int first, int last)
    int[] result := []
    for: first <= number <= last
        result = result.append(number)
    return result

bool contains_number(int[] numbers, int value)
    for number := numbers[]
        if number == value
            return true
    return false

int[] excluding(int[] numbers, int[] removed)
    int[] result := []
    for number := numbers[]
        if not contains_number(removed, number)
            result = result.append(number)
    return result

string format_real(real64 value)
    result := "{value:.4}"
    return if result == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else result

string number_list(int[] numbers)
    if #numbers == 0
        return "none"
    string[] result := []
    for number := numbers.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(string(number))
    return result.join(" ")

string limits_text(string label, variable.Limits limits)
    return "{label} lcl {format_real(limits.lcl)} cl {format_real(limits.cl)} ucl {format_real(limits.ucl)}"

string pair_text(int family, variable.Limits[] limits)
    string[] labels := if family == 0 then ["XBAR", "R"] elif family == 1 then ["XBAR", "S"] else ["I", "MR"]
    return limits_text(labels[0], limits[0]) + " " + limits_text(labels[1], limits[1])

string status_text(bool converged)
    return if converged then "converged" else "stopped"

class Series(int[] numbers, real64[] values)

class EstimationPass(int points, variable.Limits[] limits, int[] outliers)

class Estimate()
    EstimationPass[] passes := []
    converged := false
    variable.Limits[] limits := []
    int[] retained := []
    int[] removed := []

class PatternCheck(string chart, int points, rules.Signal[] signals)

class Proposal(int family, int points, variable.Limits[] limits)

class CusumPoint(int subgroup, real64 upper, real64 lower)

class BandPoint(int subgroup, real64 value, real64 width, local real64 center)
    lcl := center - width
    ucl := center + width

class Event(int number, int start, int end)
    rules.Signal[] signals := []
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    kind := ""
    onset := start
    real64 shift := 0.0
    real64 spread := 0.0
    out_of_spec := 0
    detection := array(9, fill = 0)

    int length()
        return end - start + 1

    bool contains(int subgroup)
        return start <= subgroup <= end

class AttributePass(int lots, real64 center, int[] outliers)

class AttributeResult(string chart)
    AttributePass[] passes := []
    converged := false
    retained := 0
    int[] removed := []
    attribute.Point[] points := []
    rules.Signal[] signals := []

class CapabilityGroup(string name, variable.Subgroup[] groups, capability.Result result)

class RollingWindow(int first, int last, capability.Result result)

int signal_key(rules.Signal signal)
    chart_rank := 0
    names := chart_names()
    for: index < #names
        if names[index] == signal.chart
            chart_rank = int(index)
            break
    int rule_rank := if signal.rule == "UPPER" then 9 elif signal.rule == "LOWER" then 10 else int(signal.rule)
    return chart_rank * 16016 + signal.end * 16 + rule_rank

class Analysis(dataset.Settings settings, int[] values, dataset.Lot[] lots)
    int size := settings.size
    int phase1 := settings.phase1
    dataset.Constants constants := dataset.control_constants(size)
    variable.Subgroup[] subgroups := variable.subgroup_statistics(values, size)
    Estimate[] estimates := []
    PatternCheck[] pattern_checks := []
    real64 mu0 := 0.0
    real64 sigma := 0.0
    real64 reference := 0.0
    real64 interval := 0.0
    real64 sbar := 0.0
    real64 ewma_width := 0.0
    real64 ma_width := 0.0
    rules.Signal[] signals := []
    CusumPoint[] cusum := []
    BandPoint[] ewma := []
    BandPoint[] moving_average := []
    Event[] events := []
    Proposal[] proposals := []
    AttributeResult[] attributes := []
    CapabilityGroup[] capability_groups := []
    RollingWindow[] rolling := []

    int signal_subgroup(rules.Signal signal)
        if signal.chart == "I" or signal.chart == "MR"
            return (signal.end - 1) / size + 1
        return signal.end

    bool has_signal(string chart, int end, rule := "")
        for signal := signals[]
            if signal.chart == chart and signal.end == end and (rule == "" or signal.rule == rule)
                return true
        return false

    int event_number(int subgroup)
        for event := events[]
            if event.contains(subgroup)
                return event.number
        return 0

    variable.Subgroup[] selected_groups(int[] numbers)
        variable.Subgroup[] result := []
        for number := numbers[]
            result = result.append(subgroups[number - 1])
        return result

    variable.Limits[] family_limits(int family, int[] numbers)
        if family == 2
            int[] chosen := []
            for number := numbers[]
                chosen = chosen.append(values[number - 1])
            return variable.individual_limits(chosen)
        return variable.subgroup_limits(selected_groups(numbers), size, constants, family == 1)

    Series[] family_series(int family, int[] numbers)
        real64[] first := []
        real64[] second := []
        if family == 2
            for: index < #numbers
                value := values[numbers[index] - 1]
                first = first.append(real64(value))
                if index > 0
                    second = second.append(real64(math.abs(value - values[numbers[index - 1] - 1])))
            return [Series(numbers, first), Series(numbers[1:<#numbers], second)]
        for number := numbers[]
            group := subgroups[number - 1]
            first = first.append(group.mean)
            second = second.append(if family == 0 then real64(group.spread) else group.sd)
        return [Series(numbers, first), Series(numbers, second)]

    Estimate estimate_family(int family)
        result := Estimate()
        count := if family == 2 then phase1 * size else phase1
        initial := consecutive(1, count)
        points := initial
        for: 1 <= pass <= settings.max_passes
            variable.Limits[] bounds := family_limits(family, points)
            Series[] sequences := family_series(family, points)
            int[] outliers := []
            for: side < #sequences
                sequence := sequences[side]
                for: index < #sequence.numbers
                    number := sequence.numbers[index]
                    if bounds[side].outside(sequence.values[index]) and not contains_number(outliers, number)
                        outliers = outliers.append(number)
            outliers = outliers.sorted()
            result.passes = result.passes.append(EstimationPass(int(#points), bounds, outliers))
            result.limits = bounds
            if #outliers == 0
                result.converged = true
                break
            if pass < settings.max_passes
                points = excluding(points, outliers)
        result.retained = points
        result.removed = excluding(initial, points)
        return result

    void .check_phase1(int family)
        estimate := estimates[family]
        Series[] sequences := family_series(family, estimate.retained)
        names := chart_names()
        for: side < #sequences
            chart := family * 2 + int(side)
            sequence := sequences[side]
            rules.Signal[] found := rules.check_rules(names[chart], sequence.numbers, sequence.values, estimate.limits[side], settings.rules[chart])
            pattern_checks = pattern_checks.append(PatternCheck(names[chart], int(#sequence.values), found))

    Series phase2_series(int chart)
        int[] numbers := []
        real64[] measured := []
        if chart >= 4
            for: phase1 * size + 1 <= sample <= int(#values)
                numbers = numbers.append(sample)
                value := if chart == 4 then values[sample - 1] else math.abs(values[sample - 1] - values[sample - 2])
                measured = measured.append(real64(value))
        else
            for: phase1 + 1 <= number <= int(#subgroups)
                group := subgroups[number - 1]
                numbers = numbers.append(number)
                measured = measured.append(if chart == 1 then real64(group.spread) elif chart == 3 then group.sd else group.mean)
        return Series(numbers, measured)

    void .monitor_cusum()
        real64 upper := 0.0
        real64 lower := 0.0
        upper_run := 0
        lower_run := 0
        for: phase1 + 1 <= number <= int(#subgroups)
            mean := subgroups[number - 1].mean
            upper = math.max(0.0, upper + (mean - mu0 - reference))
            lower = math.max(0.0, lower + (mu0 - mean - reference))
            upper_run = if upper > 0.0 then upper_run + 1 else 0
            lower_run = if lower > 0.0 then lower_run + 1 else 0
            cusum = cusum.append(CusumPoint(number, upper, lower))
            if upper > interval
                signals = signals.append(rules.Signal("CUSUM", "UPPER", number - upper_run + 1, number, upper, "UP"))
                upper = 0.0
                upper_run = 0
            if lower > interval
                signals = signals.append(rules.Signal("CUSUM", "LOWER", number - lower_run + 1, number, lower, "DOWN"))
                lower = 0.0
                lower_run = 0

    void .add_band_signal(string chart, BandPoint point, int start)
        if point.value > point.ucl
            signals = signals.append(rules.Signal(chart, "UPPER", start, point.subgroup, point.value, "UP"))
        elif point.value < point.lcl
            signals = signals.append(rules.Signal(chart, "LOWER", start, point.subgroup, point.value, "DOWN"))

    void .monitor_ewma()
        weight := settings.ewma_lambda
        spread := settings.ewma_l
        decay := (1.0 - weight) * (1.0 - weight)
        ratio := weight / (2.0 - weight)
        ewma_width = spread * sigma * math.sqrt(ratio)
        smoothed := mu0
        real64 factor := 1.0
        for: phase1 + 1 <= number <= int(#subgroups)
            smoothed = weight * subgroups[number - 1].mean + (1.0 - weight) * smoothed
            factor *= decay
            real64 width := spread * sigma * math.sqrt(ratio * (1.0 - factor))
            point := BandPoint(number, smoothed, width, mu0)
            ewma = ewma.append(point)
            .add_band_signal("EWMA", point, number)

    void .monitor_moving_average()
        span := settings.ma_span
        ma_width = 3.0 * sigma / math.sqrt(real64(span))
        for: phase1 + 1 <= number <= int(#subgroups)
            first := math.max(phase1 + 1, number - span + 1)
            count := number - first + 1
            total := 0
            for: first <= index <= number
                total += subgroups[index - 1].total
            real64 width := 3.0 * sigma / math.sqrt(real64(count))
            point := BandPoint(number, real64(total) / real64(size * count), width, mu0)
            moving_average = moving_average.append(point)
            .add_band_signal("MA", point, first)

    void characterize(Event &event)
        has_cusum := false
        names := chart_names()
        for signal := signals[]
            int subgroup := signal_subgroup(signal)
            if not event.contains(subgroup)
                continue
            event.signals = event.signals.append(signal)
            location := signal.chart == "XBAR_R" or signal.chart == "XBAR_S" or signal.chart == "I" or signal.chart == "CUSUM" or signal.chart == "EWMA" or signal.chart == "MA"
            category := if signal.direction == "NONE" then 4 elif location then (if signal.direction == "UP" then 0 else 1) else (if signal.direction == "UP" then 2 else 3)
            event.counts[category] += 1
            if signal.chart == "CUSUM"
                event.onset = if has_cusum then math.min(event.onset, signal.start) else signal.start
                has_cusum = true
            for: chart < #names
                if names[chart] == signal.chart
                    if event.detection[chart] == 0 or subgroup < event.detection[chart]
                        event.detection[chart] = subgroup
        largest := 0
        for: 1 <= index < 5
            if event.counts[index] > event.counts[largest]
                largest = index
        types := ["SHIFT_UP", "SHIFT_DOWN", "SPREAD_UP", "SPREAD_DOWN", "PATTERN"]
        event.kind = types[largest]
        total := 0
        real64 sd_sum := 0.0
        for: event.start <= number <= event.end
            group := subgroups[number - 1]
            total += group.total
            sd_sum += group.sd
            for value := group.values[]
                if value < settings.lsl or value > settings.usl
                    event.out_of_spec += 1
        mean := real64(total) / real64(size * event.length())
        event.shift = (mean - mu0) / sigma
        event.spread = (sd_sum / real64(event.length())) / sbar

    void .build_events()
        int[] groups := []
        for signal := signals[]
            int subgroup := signal_subgroup(signal)
            if not contains_number(groups, subgroup)
                groups = groups.append(subgroup)
        for subgroup := groups.sorted()[]
            last := int(#events) - 1
            if last >= 0 and subgroup - events[last].end - 1 <= settings.event_gap
                events[last].end = subgroup
            else
                events = events.append(Event(int(#events) + 1, subgroup, subgroup))
        for: index < #events
            characterize(&events[index])

    void .propose_limits()
        int[] free := []
        for: phase1 + 1 <= subgroup <= int(#subgroups)
            if event_number(subgroup) == 0
                free = free.append(subgroup)
        for: family < 3
            points := estimates[family].retained
            for subgroup := free[]
                if family == 2
                    points = points.concat(consecutive((subgroup - 1) * size + 1, subgroup * size))
                else
                    points = points.append(subgroup)
            proposals = proposals.append(Proposal(family, int(#points), family_limits(family, points)))

    AttributeResult estimate_attribute(string chart)
        result := AttributeResult(chart)
        chosen := lots
        center := attribute.Center(chart, chosen)
        for: 1 <= pass <= settings.max_passes
            int[] outliers := []
            for lot := chosen[]
                point := attribute.Point(lot, center)
                if point.status != "ok"
                    outliers = outliers.append(lot.number)
            result.passes = result.passes.append(AttributePass(int(#chosen), center.value, outliers))
            if #outliers == 0
                result.converged = true
                break
            if pass < settings.max_passes
                dataset.Lot[] remaining := []
                for lot := chosen[]
                    if not contains_number(outliers, lot.number)
                        remaining = remaining.append(lot)
                chosen = remaining
                center = attribute.Center(chart, chosen)
        int[] retained := []
        for lot := chosen[]
            retained = retained.append(lot.number)
        result.retained = int(#chosen)
        int[] numbers := []
        real64[] standardized := []
        for lot := lots[]
            if not contains_number(retained, lot.number)
                result.removed = result.removed.append(lot.number)
            point := attribute.Point(lot, center)
            result.points = result.points.append(point)
            numbers = numbers.append(lot.number)
            standardized = standardized.append(point.z)
        result.signals = rules.check_rules(chart, numbers, standardized, variable.Limits(-3.0, 0.0, 3.0), settings.rules[6])
        return result

    void .assess_capability()
        variable.Subgroup[] retained := selected_groups(estimates[0].retained)
        monitored := subgroups[phase1:<#subgroups]
        capability_groups = [CapabilityGroup("phase1", retained, capability.Result(retained, settings, constants)), CapabilityGroup("phase2", monitored, capability.Result(monitored, settings, constants))]
        width := settings.rolling_window
        first := phase1 + 1
        while first + width - 1 <= int(#subgroups)
            chosen := subgroups[first - 1:<first + width - 1]
            rolling = rolling.append(RollingWindow(first, first + width - 1, capability.Result(chosen, settings, constants)))
            first += settings.rolling_step

    void .run()
        for: family < 3
            estimates = estimates.append(estimate_family(family))
        for: family < 3
            .check_phase1(family)
        mu0 = estimates[0].limits[0].cl
        sigma = estimates[0].limits[1].cl / constants.d2 / math.sqrt(real64(size))
        reference = settings.cusum_k * sigma
        interval = settings.cusum_h * sigma
        sbar = estimates[1].limits[1].cl
        names := chart_names()
        for: chart < 6
            Series sequence := phase2_series(chart)
            signals = signals.concat(rules.check_rules(names[chart], sequence.numbers, sequence.values, estimates[chart / 2].limits[chart % 2], settings.rules[chart]))
        .monitor_cusum()
        .monitor_ewma()
        .monitor_moving_average()
        for: 1 <= index < int(#signals)
            entry := signals[index]
            key := signal_key(entry)
            position := index
            while position > 0 and signal_key(signals[position - 1]) > key
                signals[position] = signals[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            signals[position] = entry
        .build_events()
        .propose_limits()
        for chart := ["p", "np", "c", "u"][]
            attributes = attributes.append(estimate_attribute(chart))
        .assess_capability()

    string phase2_summary(int chart)
        names := chart_names()
        rules.Signal[] found := []
        int[] ends := []
        for signal := signals[]
            if signal.chart == names[chart]
                found = found.append(signal)
                if not contains_number(ends, signal.end)
                    ends = ends.append(signal.end)
        string[] selected := []
        if chart < 6
            for rule := settings.rules[chart][]
                selected = selected.append(string(rule))
        else
            selected = ["UPPER", "LOWER"]
        string[] counts := []
        for rule := selected[]
            count := 0
            for signal := found[]
                if signal.rule == rule
                    count += 1
            counts = counts.append("{rule}:{count}")
        points := if chart == 4 or chart == 5 then int(#values) - phase1 * size else int(#subgroups) - phase1
        first := if #ends == 0 then "none" else string(ends[0])
        counts_text := counts.join(" ")
        return "phase2 {names[chart]} points {points} signals {#found} signalled {#ends} first {first} by_rule {counts_text}"

    string[] limits_lines()
        lines := ["characteristic {settings.characteristic}", "subgroup_size {size}", "subgroups {#subgroups}", "samples {#values}", "phase1_subgroups {phase1}"]
        names := family_names()
        for: family < 3
            estimate := estimates[family]
            lines = lines.append("family {names[family]}")
            for: index < #estimate.passes
                record := estimate.passes[index]
                lines = lines.append("pass {index + 1} points {record.points} {pair_text(family, record.limits)} out {number_list(record.outliers)}")
            lines = lines.append("result {status_text(estimate.converged)} passes {#estimate.passes} retained {#estimate.retained} removed {number_list(estimate.removed)}")
        for check := pattern_checks[]
            for signal := check.signals[]
                lines = lines.append("phase1_signal {check.chart} {signal.rule} {signal.start} {signal.end} {format_real(signal.value)}")
            lines = lines.append("phase1_check {check.chart} points {check.points} signals {#check.signals}")
        for proposal := proposals[]
            lines = lines.append("proposed {names[proposal.family]} points {proposal.points} {pair_text(proposal.family, proposal.limits)}")
        target := "target {format_real(mu0)} sigma {format_real(sigma)}"
        lines = lines.append("cusum {target} k {format_real(reference)} h {format_real(interval)}")
        lines = lines.append("ewma {target} lcl {format_real(mu0 - ewma_width)} ucl {format_real(mu0 + ewma_width)}")
        lines = lines.append("ma {target} span {settings.ma_span} lcl {format_real(mu0 - ma_width)} ucl {format_real(mu0 + ma_width)}")
        for: chart < 9
            lines = lines.append(phase2_summary(chart))
        return lines

    string[] signal_lines()
        lines := ["chart,rule,start,end,value,direction"]
        for signal := signals[]
            lines = lines.append("{signal.chart},{signal.rule},{signal.start},{signal.end},{format_real(signal.value)},{signal.direction}")
        return lines

    string[] event_lines()
        lines := ["events {#events}"]
        names := chart_names()
        for event := events[]
            string[] active := []
            string[] detected := []
            for: chart < #names
                int number := event.detection[chart]
                point := if number == 0 then "-" else string(number)
                detected = detected.append("{names[chart]}:{point}")
                if number > 0
                    active = active.append(names[chart])
            active_text := active.join(",")
            detection_text := detected.join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("event {event.number} start {event.start} end {event.end} length {event.length()} signals {#event.signals} charts {active_text} location_up {event.counts[0]} location_down {event.counts[1]} spread_up {event.counts[2]} spread_down {event.counts[3]} pattern {event.counts[4]} onset {event.onset} shift {format_real(event.shift)} spread {format_real(event.spread)} out_of_spec {event.out_of_spec} type {event.kind}")
            lines = lines.append("detection {event.number} {detection_text}")
        return lines

    string[] subgroup_lines()
        lines := ["subgroup,phase,mean,zone,range,sd,cusum_upper,cusum_lower,ewma,ma,signals,event"]
        zones := rules.Zones(estimates[0].limits[0])
        for group := subgroups[]
            number := group.number
            phase := "phase1"
            monitored := ["-", "-", "-", "-"]
            if number > phase1
                index := number - phase1 - 1
                phase = "phase2"
                monitored = [format_real(cusum[index].upper), format_real(cusum[index].lower), format_real(ewma[index].value), format_real(moving_average[index].value)]
            elif contains_number(estimates[0].removed, number)
                phase = "excluded"
            count := 0
            for signal := signals[]
                if signal_subgroup(signal) == number
                    count += 1
            int event := event_number(number)
            event_text := if event == 0 then "-" else string(event)
            monitored_text := monitored.join(",")
            lines = lines.append("{number},{phase},{format_real(group.mean)},{rules.zone_name(zones, group.mean)},{group.spread},{format_real(group.sd)},{monitored_text},{count},{event_text}")
        return lines

    string[] attribute_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for result := attributes[]
            lines = lines.append("chart {result.chart}")
            for: index < #result.passes
                record := result.passes[index]
                lines = lines.append("pass {index + 1} lots {record.lots} center {format_real(record.center)} out {number_list(record.outliers)}")
            lines = lines.append("result {status_text(result.converged)} passes {#result.passes} retained {result.retained} removed {number_list(result.removed)}")
            for: index < #lots
                lot := lots[index]
                point := result.points[index]
                value := if result.chart == "np" then string(lot.defectives) elif result.chart == "c" then string(lot.defects) else format_real(point.value)
                lines = lines.append("lot {lot.number} size {lot.inspected} value {value} lcl {format_real(point.lcl)} ucl {format_real(point.ucl)} z {format_real(point.z)} status {point.status}")
            for signal := result.signals[]
                lines = lines.append("signal {signal.rule} {signal.start} {signal.end} {format_real(signal.value)}")
            lines = lines.append("signals {#result.signals}")
        return lines

    string[] out_of_spec_lines(variable.Subgroup[] chosen)
        string[] lines := []
        for group := chosen[]
            for: index < #group.values
                value := group.values[index]
                if value < settings.lsl or value > settings.usl
                    sample := (group.number - 1) * size + int(index) + 1
                    side := if value < settings.lsl then "low" else "high"
                    lines = lines.append("out_of_spec sample {sample} subgroup {group.number} value {value} side {side}")
        return lines

    string[] capability_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for group := capability_groups[]
            result := group.result
            lines = lines.append("group {group.name} subgroups {#group.groups} values {result.count}")
            labels := ["mean", "sigma_within", "sigma_sbar", "sigma_overall", "cp", "cpu", "cpl", "cpk", "pp", "ppu", "ppl", "ppk", "cpm"]
            real64[] measures := [result.mean, result.sigma_within, result.sigma_sbar, result.sigma_overall, result.within.potential, result.within.upper, result.within.lower, result.within.minimum, result.overall.potential, result.overall.upper, result.overall.lower, result.overall.minimum, result.cpm]
            for: index < #labels
                lines = lines.append("{labels[index]} {format_real(measures[index])}")
            lines = lines.append("cpk_ci {format_real(result.cpk_interval.lower)} {format_real(result.cpk_interval.upper)}")
            lines = lines.append("ppk_ci {format_real(result.ppk_interval.lower)} {format_real(result.ppk_interval.upper)}")
            lines = lines.append("below_lsl {result.below}")
            lines = lines.append("above_usl {result.above}")
            lines = lines.append("ppm {format_real(result.ppm)}")
            lines = lines.concat(out_of_spec_lines(group.groups))
            lines = lines.append("verdict {result.verdict}")
            for row := result.bins[]
                string[] parts := ["bin", string(row.lower), string(row.upper), string(row.frequency)]
                if row.length > 0
                    parts = parts.append("#" * nat(row.length))
                lines = lines.append(parts.concat(row.marks).join(" "))
        for window := rolling[]
            result := window.result
            lines = lines.append("rolling {window.first} {window.last} mean {format_real(result.mean)} sigma_within {format_real(result.sigma_within)} sigma_overall {format_real(result.sigma_overall)} cpk {format_real(result.within.minimum)} ppk {format_real(result.overall.minimum)} verdict {result.verdict}")
        return lines

    string[] limits_picture(string name, string chart, int family, int side)
        estimate := estimates[family]
        bounds := estimate.limits[side]
        lines := [limits_text("chart " + name, bounds)]
        for group := subgroups[]
            number := group.number
            mark := if number > phase1 then "2" elif contains_number(estimate.removed, number) then "x" else "1"
            real64 value := if name == "XBAR" then group.mean elif name == "R" then real64(group.spread) else group.sd
            band := plot.limits_band(bounds, value, number > phase1 and has_signal(chart, number))
            lines = lines.append("{number:3.} {mark} {band} {format_real(value)}")
        return lines

    string[] band_picture(string chart, BandPoint[] points, real64 scale)
        bounds := variable.Limits(mu0 - scale, mu0, mu0 + scale)
        lines := [limits_text("chart " + chart, bounds)]
        for point := points[]
            band := plot.width_band(scale, point.width, point.value, mu0, has_signal(chart, point.subgroup))
            lines = lines.append("{point.subgroup:3.} {band} {format_real(point.value)} {format_real(point.lcl)} {format_real(point.ucl)}")
        return lines

    string[] chart_lines()
        string[] lines := limits_picture("XBAR", "XBAR_R", 0, 0)
        lines = lines.concat(limits_picture("R", "R", 0, 1))
        lines = lines.concat(limits_picture("S", "S", 1, 1))
        lines = lines.append("chart CUSUM h {format_real(interval)}")
        for point := cusum[]
            band := plot.cusum_band(point.upper, point.lower, interval, has_signal("CUSUM", point.subgroup, "UPPER"), has_signal("CUSUM", point.subgroup, "LOWER"))
            lines = lines.append("{point.subgroup:3.} {band} {format_real(point.upper)} {format_real(point.lower)}")
        lines = lines.concat(band_picture("EWMA", ewma, ewma_width))
        lines = lines.concat(band_picture("MA", moving_average, ma_width))
        pictures := ["P_STD", "NP_STD", "C_STD", "U_STD"]
        for: chart < #attributes
            result := attributes[chart]
            lines = lines.append("chart {pictures[chart]} lcl -3.0000 cl 0.0000 ucl 3.0000")
            for: index < #lots
                number := lots[index].number
                point := result.points[index]
                band := plot.standard_band(point.z, point.status == "ok")
                lines = lines.append("{number:3.} {band} {format_real(point.z)}")
        return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

if main
    settings := dataset.read_settings()
    values := dataset.read_measurements()
    dataset.Lot[] lots := dataset.read_attributes()
    analysis := Analysis(settings, values, lots)
    .analysis.run()
    if not file.is_directory("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("limits.txt", analysis.limits_lines())
    write_lines("signals.csv", analysis.signal_lines())
    write_lines("events.txt", analysis.event_lines())
    write_lines("subgroups.csv", analysis.subgroup_lines())
    write_lines("attribute_charts.txt", analysis.attribute_lines())
    write_lines("capability.txt", analysis.capability_lines())
    write_lines("charts.txt", analysis.chart_lines())

import math
import variable = "./variable_charts.qui"

void place(string[] &band, int position, string symbol)
    band[math.min(60, math.max(0, position))] = symbol

string[] framed(int center)
    band := array(61, fill = ".")
    place(&band, 0, ":")
    place(&band, 60, ":")
    place(&band, center, "|")
    return band

string limits_band(variable.Limits limits, real64 value, bool signalled)
    span := limits.ucl - limits.lcl
    center := int(math.floor(60.0 * ((limits.cl - limits.lcl) / span) + 0.5))
    band := framed(center)
    position := int(math.floor(60.0 * ((value - limits.lcl) / span) + 0.5))
    place(&band, position, if signalled then "*" else "o")
    return band.join("")

string cusum_band(real64 upper, real64 lower, real64 threshold, bool upper_signal, bool lower_signal)
    band := framed(30)
    if lower > 0.0
        offset := math.min(30, int(math.floor(30.0 * (lower / threshold) + 0.5)))
        place(&band, 30 - offset, if lower_signal then "*" else "-")
    if upper > 0.0
        offset := math.min(30, int(math.floor(30.0 * (upper / threshold) + 0.5)))
        place(&band, 30 + offset, if upper_signal then "*" else "+")
    return band.join("")

string width_band(real64 scale, real64 width, real64 value, real64 center, bool signalled)
    band := array(61, fill = ".")
    edge := math.min(30, int(math.floor(30.0 * (width / scale) + 0.5)))
    place(&band, 30, "|")
    place(&band, 30 - edge, ":")
    place(&band, 30 + edge, ":")
    deviation := (value - center) / scale
    place(&band, 30 + int(math.floor(30.0 * deviation + 0.5)), if signalled then "*" else "o")
    return band.join("")

string standard_band(real64 z, bool ok)
    band := framed(30)
    place(&band, 30 + int(math.floor(10.0 * z + 0.5)), if ok then "o" else "*")
    return band.join("")

import variable = "./variable_charts.qui"

class Zones(local variable.Limits limits)
    real64 lcl := limits.lcl
    real64 cl := limits.cl
    real64 ucl := limits.ucl
    local upper_step := (ucl - cl) / 3.0
    local lower_step := (cl - lcl) / 3.0
    real64 u1 := cl + upper_step
    real64 u2 := cl + 2.0 * upper_step
    real64 l1 := cl - lower_step
    real64 l2 := cl - 2.0 * lower_step

class Signal(string chart, string rule, int start, int end, real64 value, string direction)

string evaluate_rule(int rule, real64[] window, Zones zones)
    last := window[-1]
    if rule == 1
        if last > zones.ucl or last < zones.lcl
            return if last > zones.cl then "UP" else "DOWN"
        return ""
    if rule == 2 or rule == 3
        upper := if rule == 2 then zones.u2 else zones.u1
        lower := if rule == 2 then zones.l2 else zones.l1
        needed := if rule == 2 then 2 else 4
        above := 0
        below := 0
        for value := window[]
            if value > upper
                above += 1
            if value < lower
                below += 1
        if last > upper and above >= needed
            return "UP"
        if last < lower and below >= needed
            return "DOWN"
        return ""
    upward := true
    downward := true
    alternating := true
    inside := true
    outside := true
    has_upper := false
    has_lower := false
    for: index < #window
        value := window[index]
        if rule == 4
            upward = upward and value > zones.cl
            downward = downward and value < zones.cl
        elif rule == 5 and index > 0
            upward = upward and value > window[index - 1]
            downward = downward and value < window[index - 1]
        if index > 0
            difference := value - window[index - 1]
            if difference == 0.0
                alternating = false
            if index > 1
                previous := window[index - 1] - window[index - 2]
                if (difference > 0.0) == (previous > 0.0)
                    alternating = false
        inside = inside and value > zones.l1 and value < zones.u1
        outside = outside and (value > zones.u1 or value < zones.l1)
        has_upper = has_upper or value > zones.u1
        has_lower = has_lower or value < zones.l1
    if rule == 4 or rule == 5
        if upward
            return "UP"
        if downward
            return "DOWN"
    if rule == 6 and alternating
        return "NONE"
    if rule == 7 and inside
        return "NONE"
    if rule == 8 and outside and has_upper and has_lower
        return "NONE"
    return ""

Signal[] check_rules(string chart, int[] numbers, real64[] values, variable.Limits limits, int[] selected)
    lengths := [1, 3, 5, 8, 6, 14, 15, 8]
    zones := Zones(limits)
    Signal[] result := []
    for: 1 <= count <= int(#values)
        for rule := selected[]
            width := lengths[rule - 1]
            if count >= width
                side := evaluate_rule(rule, values[count - width:<count], zones)
                if side != ""
                    result = result.append(Signal(chart, string(rule), numbers[count - width], numbers[count - 1], values[count - 1], side))
    return result

string zone_name(Zones zones, real64 value)
    if value > zones.ucl
        return "OUT+"
    if value < zones.lcl
        return "OUT-"
    if value > zones.u2
        return "A+"
    if value > zones.u1
        return "B+"
    if value > zones.cl
        return "C+"
    if value < zones.l2
        return "A-"
    if value < zones.l1
        return "B-"
    if value < zones.cl
        return "C-"
    return "C0"

import math
import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

int total_values(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

class Subgroup(int number, int[] values)
    total := total_values(values)
    squares := 0
    local low := values[0]
    local high := low
    for value := values[]
        squares += value * value
        low = math.min(low, value)
        high = math.max(high, value)
    int spread := high - low
    mean := real64(total) / real64(#values)
    local count := int(#values)
    real64 sd := math.sqrt(real64(count * squares - total * total) / real64(count * (count - 1)))

Subgroup[] subgroup_statistics(int[] values, int size)
    Subgroup[] result := []
    for: start < int(#values) step size
        result = result.append(Subgroup(start / size + 1, values[start:<start + size]))
    return result

int[] moving_ranges(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#values)
        result = result.append(math.abs(values[index] - values[index - 1]))
    return result

class Limits(real64 lcl, real64 cl, real64 ucl)
    bool outside(real64 value)
        return value < lcl or value > ucl

Limits[] subgroup_limits(Subgroup[] groups, int size, dataset.Constants constants, bool use_sd)
    total := 0
    range_sum := 0
    real64 sd_sum := 0.0
    for group := groups[]
        total += group.total
        range_sum += group.spread
        sd_sum += group.sd
    count := real64(#groups)
    center := real64(total) / real64(int(#groups) * size)
    if use_sd
        average := sd_sum / count
        return [Limits(center - constants.a3 * average, center, center + constants.a3 * average), Limits(constants.b3 * average, average, constants.b4 * average)]
    average := real64(range_sum) / count
    return [Limits(center - constants.a2 * average, center, center + constants.a2 * average), Limits(constants.d3 * average, average, constants.d4 * average)]

Limits[] individual_limits(int[] values)
    constants := dataset.control_constants(2)
    ranges := moving_ranges(values)
    center := real64(total_values(values)) / real64(#values)
    average := real64(total_values(ranges)) / real64(#ranges)
    return [Limits(center - 3.0 * average / constants.d2, center, center + 3.0 * average / constants.d2), Limits(constants.d3 * average, average, constants.d4 * average)]
